import os
import pandas as pd
import style_config   # 确保 style_config.py 在项目根目录

RAW_DATA_PATH = 'data/raw/SpotifyTracks.csv'

style_config.set_plot_style()

# 4️⃣ 读取 CSV

# 5️⃣ 输出数据概况

print("\n列类型：")
print(df.dtypes)

# 6️⃣ 简单初步清洗

print("\n🎯 接下来建议：打开 week1/week1_exploration.ipynb，开始 Week 1 Notebook 任务")
